page: Microsoft Azure E16ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The hardware profile is driven by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor operating at 4.2 GHz with an x86_64 architecture. Allocation provides 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with two threads per core. Cache configuration includes 48 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and 260 MB of shared L3 cache. The architecture incorporates advanced execution extensions such as AVX-512, AMX tile and INT8 instructions, and hardware-accelerated cryptography. System memory totals 128.0 GB, delivering 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Ephemeral local storage is bundled directly via a 944 GB NVMe SSD. The instance contains zero discrete GPUs and allocates zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Performance benchmarks position the instance within the median tier for broad compute tasks while excelling in targeted operations. PassMark CPU testing logged a score of 25768.7, accompanied by a Geekbench multi-core rating of 10558.0 and a stress-ng multi-core measurement of 15971.68. Memory bandwidth throughput reaches 123.39 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 69.2 GB/sec for large writes. Compression benchmarks demonstrate upper-quartile capability, with single-threaded gzip reaching 31.34 GB/sec. Low-parameter artificial intelligence inference also ranks in the top quartile, achieving 302.3 tokens per second on a small 135M model, aided by integrated AMX extensions.

From an infrastructure perspective, bundling 944 GB of high-speed local NVMe storage with 128 GB of RAM provides operational cost efficiency by eliminating reliance on external network volumes for temporary databases and high-churn cache layers. Tradeoffs include average general-purpose multithreaded compute margins relative to core count and an absence of hardware acceleration for larger deep learning workloads. The configuration is best aligned with transactional databases, Redis caching clusters, ETL workloads, and memory-bound enterprise applications.
description: Microsoft Azure E16ds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 16 vCPUs and 8 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8573C processor at 4.2 GHz. Built on x86_64 architecture with Microsoft Hyper-V, it provides 128.0 GB of memory, equating to 8.0 GB per vCPU, alongside a bundled 944 GB local NVMe SSD. The CPU integrates vector and matrix extensions including AVX-512 and Intel AMX, while omitting discrete graphics processors. Benchmark evaluations demonstrate consistent mid-tier CPU and memory performance, supported by strong results in single-threaded gzip compression at 31.34 GB/sec and lightweight LLM inference. Incorporating fast local storage with high memory density yields solid resource efficiency for memory-intensive operations. The instance is recommended for relational database hosting, Redis key-value stores, real-time caching, and data processing workflows.
